title: Hyannis Whale Watcher Cruises
specs: Guaranteed whale sightings including humpback, fin, and minke whales
Vessel is 26 years old, spacious with indoor and outdoor seating
Recognized by WhaleSENSE and NOAA Northeast Whale Watching Guidelines
No stated weight or health restrictions
Capacity limited on extended whale watch for comfort
includes: Food, beverage and bar service available on board
Breakfast and lunch options on extended whale watch
gap: Exact price for standard whale watching cruise not stated
blurb: Guests embark on 3.5 to 4 hour narrated whale watching trips from Barnstable Harbor, observing humpback, fin, and minke whales, as well as seals and dolphins. An extended 6-hour deep-sea adventure is also offered, including a wildlife photography workshop and marine wildlife insights. Food, beverage, and bar service are available on board, with indoor and outdoor seating.
extraNote: Parking $15 cash next to the harbour · E-tickets available for purchase online · Barnstable Harbor · Summer season, with trips available at least through September

quotes.text: Wow 5 STAR day out today – absolutely loved the whole experience! We were so lucky and saw so many humpback whales, minke and a couple of grey seals! Great team on board, excellent commentary – very educational and knew their stuff. Snack bar well equipped. You can buy DVD or link for $45 that will include everything from your trip. Parking is $15 cash next to the harbour – really nice little snack place there as well. Book – you will not be disappointed!

It was great! Staff were very knowledgeable and kind. We saw a total of 20-25 humpback whales, a minke whale, and a seal. People say that the front of the boat is mainly pointed towards the whales, which is due to them trying to not disturb the whale’s natural behavior. You get a pretty good view as well when sitting on the sides of the boat and we were surrounded by whales so everyone got to see something. I would definitely recommend!

Such an incredible experience! The boat spacious, with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. They sell food and drinks, or you can bring your own. The crew is great and helps to identify the sea life. We saw 25 whales, including calves! And a seal. We also got to see several humpback whales breach, which was amazing. We would do this again in a heartbeat!

We had the best trip. It was a very foggy morning but when we got to the area we saw so many. There were two whales with their calf’s. Several whales including one of the babies breached the water. Some were so close to the boat you could see the baleen in their mouths. The crew was informative and friendly. I highly recommend this trip.

This cruise was the highlight of our vacation! We saw lots of whales. The captain made sure to give us plenty of time to enjoy watching them in the water. He even stopped on the way back when he saw some whales at play.
Amazing experience!! It was kind of a chilly rainy day and we ended up having the absolute best time, we saw over nine whales! The crew was all very lovely and the boat was clean and comfortable.
